name: Side Eye Dog
subject: an unnamed dog in a car
origin: Posted to Reddit's r/aww in 2015 by /u/gooddboyy, suspecting a car ride was really a trip to the vet; widely used as the 'sus dog' from around 2021.

sources.label: Know Your Meme — the Side-Eyeing Dog explained

cultural_meaning: Narrowed, sideways suspicion — the look of someone who knows what you are not saying.

reflection.en: He looks at you as if he already knows where the car is going.
reflection.ru: Он смотрит так, будто уже знает, куда едет машина.
reflection.de: Er schaut, als wüsste er schon, wohin das Auto fährt.

notes: Annotated from the KYM description (narrowed eyes, one ear inside out); the body is barely visible. look_aside needs operator approval; otherwise the robot stands.
discovered_via: manual (Imgflip lists only This Is Fine and Buff Doge vs. Cheems)
